declarations.rationale: Explicit include and members-of-population context form the largest coherent demographic family; this does not assert universal subgroup containment.
Headquarters-in/location paths dominate, with workers/staff at the site as additional institutional location context.
Flow/empty/meander-to by river is the unique specific directional family; corporate asset and generic co-subject rows are not combined into it.
Inverse spokesman attribution paths dominate over military/geographic meanings.
Explicit adviser-poss is the highest repeated interpretable role path; travel-with aide and other office/location snippets are distinct. Weak minority role retained.
Museum/venue be-at and full address paths dominate.
Outlast is the dominant explicit contest-result path, alongside overtake whose result versus standings meaning requires case review.
Coach-at and explicit coach-role paths form the largest family.
Corporate owned-by/division/unit paths form the largest specific family.
Explicit public official/chief/supervisor and branch-role paths form the largest governmental-official family, distinct from economist role alone and geographic presence.
Unit/part-of-office corporate paths form the largest repeated meaning, ahead of political office. Geographic placeholders remain ambiguous.
Fire/dismiss employee paths dominate; replace/choose alone require the declared employment-removal meaning.
Explicit lawyer specializing/expert/authority in a legal field overwhelmingly dominates.
Executive-office record and institutional presiding form the largest coherent managerial family; editor and personal appearance are distinct.
Explicit public official and established governmental job/post tenure form the dominant family; chairperson and sports opposition are separate.
